'''Wingnut''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|fought]] at [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] with [[Hammer Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hammer Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A greenie flying under the callsign '''Hammer Two''', his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was damaged by two [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and he was forced to return to the ''[[Pioneer]]'' for repairs. He later became a trainer for heavy munitions among other pilots.<ref name="Stealth" />
